title: On Weak Probabilistic φ-Contractions in Menger Spaces
content: In this paper, we introduce two new concepts: (0,∞)-dense set and weak probabilistic φ-contraction. Then we prove a fixed point theorem for weak probabilsticφ-contraction in Menger spaces, which generalizes and unifies several results in existing literatures. Finally, we provide an example to demonstrate the validity of our results.
